settings.subtitle: Baby Carriers
settings.title: We want to help you find the perfect baby carrier for your needs
settings.text:
It’s no secret that here at Natural Baby Shower we LOVE babywearing. There is a long list of benefits of babywearing for both parent and baby; from creating a closer bond, to helping their social development and helping to comfort baby. The list goes on and on, but the world of baby carriers can feel a little confusing with so many different options. So we want to help!

This handy guide will explain the most important things you need to know and help you feel confident in your purchasing decisions. Once you know what different type of baby carriers there are and how they can make your life on the move easier, the decision will be simple!

settings.title: What are the different types of baby carriers?

settings.text:
In the current market of baby carriers, there's a wide array of options featuring terminology like buckles, wraps, and slings. With such a diverse selection, it can be rather confusing to determine the right choice for your needs. Understanding the distinctions between these various carrier types is essential for making an educated decision that suits both you and your baby.

So what is the difference between each one, and what are the pros and cons? Let’s take a closer look.

settings.title: Newborn carrier
settings.text: Newborn carriers are one of the easiest ways to promote bonding while your baby is still a newborn. Safely close to your heart, newborn carriers offer padded, ergonomic and hands-free support for you and baby. These carriers can even work for breastfeeding.

settings.title: Wrap
settings.text: Baby wrap carriers offer a versatile and secure way to keep your infant close. Soft wraps allow parents to carry their babies hands-free, promoting bonding and comfort. They adapt to your baby's growth, offering front and back carrying options through various techniques.

settings.title: Buckle
settings.text: They all have a soft padded structure that supports your baby and is secured around your body with buckles and adjustable straps. They are quick and easy to put on and easily adjustable, you can be good to go in a matter of a few clicks and pulls in the right places.

So now you know what the different types of baby carriers there are, how do you know which one is right for you? Before you start shopping for your baby carrier, it is good to know what to look out for and what the most important features need to be.

Keep the following points in mind when you are shopping and researching to help you pick the perfect baby carrier.

settings.title: Newborn
settings.text: If you are planning to use your baby carrier from birth, you need to make sure it is suitable for newborns. Some carriers are designed for certain stages, whereas some are adaptable to suit more than one stage so we always encourage you to double check they are suitable for newborns. Whilst wrap carriers are always suitable from birth, some soft structured carriers are not, and may need an additional newborn insert to use from birth. Always check your baby meets the minimum weight requirement as this can vary between models.

settings.title: Longevity
settings.text: Think about how long you'll want to carry your little one. If you anticipate extended use, opting for a carrier with a higher weight limit, along with exceptional versatility and adjustability, is a smart choice. These styles provide excellent value, accommodating various carrying methods and adapting to the evolving needs of your growing child.

settings.title: Comfort
settings.text: Let's talk about comfort – for both you and your baby. When your baby carrier is designed with your comfort in mind, you'll not only enjoy carrying your baby more, but you'll also be able to do it for longer stretches. Seek carriers with plush, cushioned shoulder and lumbar straps crafted from durable, breathable, and soft materials for all round ease. And don't forget about your little one – ensure the carrier provides the right ergonomic support for their head, neck, and legs.

settings.title: Accessories
settings.text: There are some really useful accessories that come with some baby carriers that can make baby wearing easier and more convenient for you. Look for baby carriers that come with the possibility of rain covers which will keep your baby protected on wet and windy days. Plus, dribble or teething bibs are also mini life savers to protect your baby carrier from dribble and drool while giving baby a safe and soft place to chew.

settings.title: Ease of use
settings.text: Pick a carrier that you feel confident putting on, know how to use and can get out of it alone. As you are running out of the house, there is nothing worse than having to tackle the task of putting on a tricky baby carrier. We always recommend to try before you buy or get a demo in our store so you know how to use it correctly. Wraps do tend to take a little more practice than soft structured carriers. It's a good idea to practice with a doll or teddy so when it comes to the real deal you are a seasoned professional.
